_note: Copy to the course root as course.json. Set language to a BCP-47 code (es, fr, ar ...) and translate the values; keep the keys. Anything left out falls back to English.

labels.exam_intro: An exam of **{n} questions** covering every chapter. Suggested time: **{minutes} minutes** in one sitting, no notes. Answer in chat as e.g. `{example} ...`, or mark `skip`. Hints are not offered during the exam (ask for them in review). The key is in `{key_file}`; open it only after you finish.
labels.exam_mixed: Chapters are mixed and unlabeled. Coverage: {coverage}.
labels.exam_key_intro: Each row shows the key, the chapter the question came from, and its source. Explanations follow.
labels.footer_facts: Facts never change with the level, only the wording, examples, order and difficulty.
labels.footer_wrong_level: Wrong level ("too simple", "too dense", "too easy", "too hard")? Tell me and I will regenerate.

ui.quizHelp: Answer with a click or with the keys A to D. Hints are optional and are marked in your score. After every answer you see why each wrong option is wrong and where the fact comes from.
